licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker (clean). The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Secco recitative: a single bass staff is printed for the keyboard, written here as the piano's left hand. Bar 1 keeps the Introduction's one flat; the key signature is cancelled from bar 2. Bars 14–17 are the beginning of Scene 3 (Donna Anna and Don Ottavio). Playback tempo: free, as recitative is sung, played at a speaking pace, ♩ = 107, about 38 seconds, from the median of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958, Giulini 1959, Böhm 1977, Haitink 1984, Karajan 1985). Most sets put "Leporello, ove sei?" and "Ah! del padre in periglio" on separate tracks (Fricsay 0:29 + 0:09, Böhm 0:31 + 0:11, Karajan 0:31 + 0:11); Giulini's and Haitink's tracks run these bars together with the neighbouring numbers, so their share was taken in proportion to the app's lengths (Giulini ≈ 0:35, Haitink ≈ 0:37); median 0:38.
